implementation: Native 3D relief and Canvas sign/illustration atlas. Masonry, glass, scaffold netting and chain-link use small procedural materials. Actual original NYC3D triangles supply all five building volumes, positions, proportions and roof heights. Detail layers are checked against these triangles by prepare-lyric.mjs. Temporary construction arrangement and small architectural details are reference-based approximations. No Google data was scraped, no screenshot textures were used, and no vehicles, NPCs or gameplay were added.
